planets.name: Kepler-22 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-22 with a 290-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: Kepler-22 b crosses its star every 290 days and is 2.1 Earth radii across, found in 2011.
text.introduction: Kepler-22 b transits Kepler-22 every 290 days and is 2.1 Earth radii across. Orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname BONOMO_ET_AL_2023): pl_orbper 289.863876, pl_radj 0.18734977, pl_bmassj 0.0286318

quotes.title: Kepler-22b
quotes.card: Kepler-22b is an exoplanet orbiting the Sun-like star Kepler-22 within its habitable zone.
quotes.introduction: It is located about 640 light-years from Earth in the constellation Cygnus.
